one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote a C image generator using unverified heuristic formulas for the ground checkerboard tile width and shadow band positions, then submitted immediately after compilation without running any pixel-level similarity check against the target image.
t_err_evidence: In step 8, the agent designs and attempts to write a C program using guessed formulas (stripe width = 2*dy/3, shadow center c2=1200-0.5*dy with radius 100, c1=1200-1.0*dy with radius 50) that were never validated against observed pixel data; these heuristic values are carried unchanged into the final code at step 9.
t_commit_evidence: Step 11 successfully compiles and runs the heuristic C generator, producing reconstructed.ppm with the unverified pattern model locked in; the agent then submits at step 12 without any corrective iteration.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed that rough geometric estimates (stripe width growing as 2*dy/3, shadow bands centered on linear functions of dy with fixed radii) were sufficient to reproduce the image at >=0.99 L2 similarity without ever validating the formulas against sampled pixel data or running a comparison after generation.
forewarning_evidence: Step 7 produced an awk syntax error when the agent tried to extract shadow band ranges, meaning it never obtained the exact x-ranges of the shadow bands needed to validate its formula. Steps 8 and 10 also produced shell errors preventing any verification of the generated output.
